case_19.kernel_family: Liger-Kernel fused cross-entropy forward with predicted-token reporting
case_19.reason: The cross-block argmax update uses `is_new_max = block_max >= m` (non-strict), so a later block whose maximum merely ties the running maximum overwrites argmax_idx with the higher index; the contract requires the lowest tied index (the comparison must be strictly `>`). Within-block tie handling via tl.min is correct, so the defect only shows when n_cols exceeds BLOCK_SIZE and ties span blocks — exactly the case the problem highlights.
